pages.text: The $(item)arc furnace$() is not a block of its own: it is a chemical vat set up to melt iron with electric arcs. It makes molten steel without a blast furnace or hot air.$(br2)$(l)The build$()

$(li)$(item)Fireproof Chemical Vat$() blocks only. Steel and cast iron vats do not work.$(li)At least $(item)9 vat blocks$(): a 3x3 vat one block high is the usual shape.$(li)$(item)3 Electrode Holders$() on top of the vat, each with a $(item)Graphite Electrode$().

$(li)$(item)No heat$() is needed: you can leave the space under the vat empty.$(br2)Any other machine you attach must be working too, or nothing runs. The simplest arc furnace has the three holders and nothing else.

$(l)Graphite electrodes$()$(br)Put a $(item)Block of Coal Coke$() in a $(item)Stonecutter$(): one block gives one graphite electrode. Right-click a holder to insert it, sneak and right-click with an empty hand to take it out. Working holders throw electric sparks into the vat.
